title: frequency-pipeline.md extraction streams (librosa 22050 Hz, hop 512, 0.5 s)

title: extract.py / extract_cli.py differences and meta output

title: analyze_tone.py: Krumhansl-Schmuckler key, absent-fifth candidate scoring (0.4·absence + 0.6·sweet), beat heuristic, default carrier 136.0
what: librosa 22050 Hz mono. chroma_cqt mean → dominant pitch class. KS profiles major [6.35,2.23,3.48,2.33,4.38,4.09,2.52,5.19,2.39,3.66,2.29,2.88], minor [6.33,2.68,3.52,5.38,2.60,3.53,2.54,4.75,3.98,2.69,3.34,3.17]; best roll → key, mode, confidence. Spectral centroid. STFT band energy sub-bass 20-80, bass 80-250, low-mid 250-500 Hz. Candidates note_freq(idx, oct) = 16.3516·2^oct·2^(idx/12) octaves 1-5 within 60-250 Hz; presence = local bin / max bin, absence = 1−presence, sweet = clamp(1−|f−140|/100); score 0.4·absence + 0.6·sweet. Beat: tempo <80 or rms_var <0.5 → 4 Hz theta; tempo <110 → 6 Hz theta-alpha; else 8 Hz alpha. Output {key, key_confidence, dominant_pitch, tempo_bpm, spectral_centroid, sub_bass_pct, bass_pct, carrier_hz, beat_hz, beat_label, binaural_left=carrier, binaural_right=carrier+beat}; default carrier 136.0. Batch runbook ignores prescription, reads absent fifth off candidate table.
how: Run on any recording Ashrey adds (temple recording, bell) to find its absent fifth.

title: temporal_analysis.py: bass-coverage verdict STRONG/MODERATE/SPARSE/ABSENT; STABLE vs MOVING carrier
what: STFT n_fft 2048 ('matches our Web Audio analyser.fftSize'), hop 512 (~43 fps). Dominant bin 50-300 Hz (threshold 0.01), 5 s windows {time, bass_hz, note, energy, bass_present_pct}; bass coverage %, note histogram, gaps >1 s. >80% STRONG; >50 MODERATE (needs fallback); >20 SPARSE ('pre-computed carrier recommended'); else ABSENT. std <30 Hz STABLE ('a fixed carrier at median would work'); else MOVING.

title: deep_analysis.py: binaural-pair detection, stereo width per band, isochronic pulse detection
what: soundfile chunked. Six 20 s L/R windows → FFT n=16384 Hann → top peaks 80-300 Hz per channel. Binaural pairs: L/R peaks 0.3 ≤ Δ ≤ 40 Hz in bands 20-80, 80-300, 300-800, labelled ≤1 delta, ≤4 theta, ≤8 alpha, ≤13 beta-low, ≤30 beta, else gamma. Stereo width: 45 s window at 35%, Butterworth bandpass, L/R corr, width = 1−|corr|; corr >0.97 MONO, >0.85 near-mono, width >0.25 stereo. Isochronic: 80-300 Hz bandpass → Hilbert envelope → ~200 Hz → FFT of envelope 1-40 Hz; peaks ≥0.18 consistent in ≥2 of 3 sections (25/50/70%). Mono files get isochronic check only.
how: Stereo check: corr >0.95 safe to add binaural.
